name: Paper Grid
tagline: favstash's paper-grid: a white paper pane with a drifting grid above the speaker, ink and navy, typing and counters.

motion.direction: favstash `paper-grid`. A white paper pane with a 45 / 180 px grid (`card` mode: pane top, speaker bottom, hard seam at y 960); white cards radius 30 with a 1 px rim, 740–820 wide, centred; ink `#0f172a`, muted `goldd`, navy `ter` / `gold`; `chips` as 64 px capsules, hero figures 200–270 px as `counter`s (20–50 frames power2.out). Entrances 0.35–0.45 s rising 50 px, exits 0.2 s, leaving 6 frames before the next item; one card at a time; the grid drifts one cell per reel. Captions 1–2 lines under the chin.
